puzzles.name: Feed Jabu-Jabu
puzzles.description: Catch a fish in a bottle and feed it to Lord Jabu-Jabu to open his mouth.
steps: Catch fish in shallow water with bottle
hints: Fish swim in fountain near altar

puzzles.name: Carry Princess Ruto
puzzles.description: Ruto must be carried through dungeon. Put her down on switches, throw her across gaps.
steps: Talk to Ruto in first room
Throw across gaps to hit switches
Don't leave her too long or she complains

puzzles.name: Boomerang Acquisition
puzzles.description: Use Boomerang to hit crystal switch through fence, then navigate to chest.
steps: Get Boomerang from chest in side room

puzzles.name: Electric Bari Navigation
puzzles.description: Stun electric Bari with Boomerang to safely pass or defeat them.
steps: Run past or attack with sword
Bari split when hit with sword - use Boomerang first

puzzles.name: Barinade Tentacle Puzzle
puzzles.description: Sever Barinade's three tentacles with Boomerang before damaging main body.
steps: Target tentacle connection points on ceiling
Throw Boomerang to sever each (3 total)
hints: Body electric barrier drops after tentacles cut

phases.name: Tentacle Defense
phases.mechanic: Barinade protected by 3 tentacles, sends out Bari

phases.name: Electric Barrier
phases.mechanic: Body surrounded by rotating electric barrier, charges player
phases.puzzle: Boomerang stuns body through barrier gap, attack nucleus
phases.vulnerability: Nucleus exposed when barrier gap aligns

phases.name: Bari Swarm
phases.mechanic: Low health - releases many Bari, body moves faster
phases.puzzle: Boomerang clears Bari, quick strikes on nucleus
